questions.q:
Suresh's expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 3 : 1. His income increases by 25%. If his savings increase by 20%, then by how much percentage does his expenditure increase?

सुरेश का व्यय और बचत 3:1 के अनुपात में है। उसकी आय में 25% की वृद्धि होती है। यदि उसकी बचत में 20% की वृद्धि होती है, तो उसके व्यय में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
questions.s:
Let initial savings = x and expenditure = 3x, so income = 3x + x = 4x.

New income = 4x X 1.25 = 5x.

New savings = x X 1.20 = 1.2x.

New expenditure = New income − New savings = 5x − 1.2x = 3.8x.

Percentage increase in expenditure = [(3.8x − 3x) / 3x] X 100

= (0.8x / 3x) X 100 ≈ 26.67%.

Answer: Approximately 26.67%

Option (d) is the correct answer.

Suresh's expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 3 : 1. His income increases by 25%. If his savings increase by 20%, then by how much percentage does his expenditure increase?

questions_hin.s_hi:
Let initial savings = x and expenditure = 3x, so income = 3x + x = 4x.

New income = 4x X 1.25 = 5x.

New savings = x X 1.20 = 1.2x.

New expenditure = New income − New savings = 5x − 1.2x = 3.8x.

Percentage increase in expenditure = [(3.8x − 3x) / 3x] X 100

= (0.8x / 3x) X 100 ≈ 26.67%.

Answer: Approximately 26.67%

Option (d) is the correct answer.

उपकरणों का मूल्य प्रत्येक वर्ष 15% तक कम हो जाता है। प्रारंभ से 3 वर्ष बाद उपकरण का मूल्य कितना प्रतिशत कम होगा?
5. यदि P का 35 प्रतिशत, Q के 60 प्रतिशत के बराबर है और Q, P का (z3) प्रतिशत है, तो z का मान कितना है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
5.(a)
P का 35% = Q का 60%
PQ = 6035=127
Q = z3% of P
QP = z3%
⇒ z = 74 × 100 = 175
